decisions.topic: Print File & Measured Image Bug Fixes
decisions.chosen: Fix Widget getParameterNode(), VTK 2-arg GetTag, DisplayNode segment visibility, ToothFairy3 vs 5-class detection, dual Pillow+Qt cross-section renderer with full H/W0/W3/W5/Nerve vectors, inline UI Measured Image Gallery, and explicit output directory saving (PDF + 300 DPI PNG + HTML)
decisions.reason: Eliminates runtime AttributeErrors/TypeErrors in 3D Slicer and ensures radiologists and dentists immediately see and export measured cross-sectional images and 10x8/8x10 film sheets.

decisions.chosen: Vivid anatomical color palette with translucent alveolar bone (0.25 default opacity), 1.0 opacity vivid teeth/roots, VR Phong shading (Ambient=0.25, Diffuse=0.88, Specular=0.45, SpecularPower=26.0 for Vivid Roots VR), glowing red/orange IAN canal, and 4 surface presets in VIVID_3D_STYLE_PRESETS
decisions.reason: Opaque jawbone previously occluded tooth roots in 3D surface and VR views; translucent bone + specular teeth makes crowns, roots, furcations, and canals vivid.

decisions.chosen: New RiseMarEngine module with user-configured checkpoint path persisted via QSettings key CBCTPlanner/RiseMarWeightsPath (CBAM Attention U-Net + sinogram/streak suppression hybrid + CQA 1-10 quality scoring)
decisions.reason: Provides on-demand Metal Artifact Reduction in Step 1 and batch CLI for scans with titanium implants, amalgam fillings, or orthodontic brackets.

decisions.chosen: Native implementations of ASO (Standardized Cranial/Occlusal Orientation), ALI (3D Dental & Cephalometric Landmark Identification), CLI-C (Impacted Canine/Molar Localization), VFACE (Bilateral Mandibular Asymmetry), and AutoCrop3D/AutoMatrix
decisions.reason: Provides immediate clinical value for orthodontists, oral surgeons, and radiologists without requiring external Conda/WSL2 setup.

decisions.chosen: W0 bridges outer-lingual to outer-buccal bone crest across the socket (expected 6.0-9.5 mm at molar) via _same_jaw_tooth_mask, _find_socket_crest_rims, _select_ridge_run_indices, _sample_band_profile; PDL gap tolerance ≤ 1.5 mm
decisions.reason: Single cortical plate measurement (2 mm) is clinically wrong on dentate sites; bridging both walls reflects true available bone width for implant planning.

decisions.chosen: PCA inside _detect_alveolar_crest_and_axis clipped on ridge_mask (<=16 mm apical) with an elongated-axis guard; prevents minor eigenvector flip at arch angles > 45 degrees
decisions.reason: Previous flip caused wrong bone segment to be identified as W0 at posterior molar sites where arch curvature is high.

decisions.chosen: Height ray extends to inferior jaw boundary on non-canal slices; stops at IAN only when a confirmed canal is present in ROI. IAN search uses u_ok=(|u|<=11.0 mm)|(|u-u_ref|<=8.5 mm) and local_radius_mm=28.0 mm
decisions.reason: Height line was stopping short on anterior mandible (no canal) and missing posterior canals > 15 mm from crest.

decisions.chosen: PanoProjectionMode defaults to 'RaySum' in CBCTPlanner, Phase7Tools, AdvancedTools, PrintLayoutEngine, PanoramicCurveLogic; never hardcode 'Mean'. Scale: accum / max(1, n_layers) * 1.25 with percentile W/L mapping.
decisions.reason: RaySum matches clinical panoramic film appearance (pseudo-DPR); Mean produced a washed-out averaged image.

decisions.chosen: Air transparent via SetApplyThreshold(True) in display; RGBA PNG capture uses SetAlphaBitPlanes(1), GradientBackgroundOff(), SetBackgroundAlpha(0.0), SetInputBufferTypeToRGBA(); _data_uri_to_image preserves RGBA; _paste_contain alpha-composites over film
decisions.reason: Previous opaque black pano/VR panels on the 8x10 film looked unprofessional and obscured the film background.

decisions.chosen: Panoramic viewport crops empty air margins isotropically; no pillarbox/letterbox black bars, no stretch. Green Foreground and Label layers cleared before pano display.
decisions.reason: Previous display had ~83% wasted side margins and 2.5x vertical stretch from uncropped 120 mm sampling height.

decisions.chosen: half_v_mm = 25.0 mm (not 30.0); 30.0 broke test_core_math.py 50x50x50 plausibility tests
decisions.reason: 30 mm exceeds the phantom volume, causing EDT boundary artifacts in unit test geometry.

decisions.chosen: OpenAI-compatible POST <base>/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer via urlsplit URL normalization (BL-17 closed); retry/backoff on 429/5xx (BL-15 closed); tolerant JSON parse; fixed action whitelist; nothing applied until 'Apply agent changes'
decisions.reason: Any gateway (OpenAI, Azure ?api-version=..., bare host, vLLM, Ollama shim, internal proxy) works with one implementation, and untrusted model output can never silently edit a clinical plan.

decisions.topic: Post-v3.2 Hardening (Pre-Print, BL-12, BL-14, BL-18, Legend Avoidance, Edentulous Arch)
decisions.chosen: Auto-populate H/W0 & last_cross_sections from MeasurementEngine in Pre-Print Editor; preserve coronal offset via reanchor_h_start_to_w0 on W0 drag; persist MeasurementOverrides in ParameterNode JSON + JSONL export; relocate W3/W5 corner legend off bone/scale bar; withhold <3 mm single-cortex W0 (BL-12) after deeper rescue; render AnnotationStore flags in 8x10 Clinical Notes strip (BL-14); verify edentulous jawbone_crest fit on real CT
decisions.reason: Fixes blank Pre-Print canvas/cells when Step 5 was skipped, prevents coronal crest collapse when dragging W0, eliminates single-plate false W0 widths, and ensures annotations and legends remain clean on clinical 8x10 film.

decisions.chosen: Qt-free core/annotations.py AnnotationStore (id, FDI, arc mm, kind, severity, author, source, timestamps, JSON round trip); GUI keeps a Qt-free _annotationRowIds map
decisions.reason: Annotations are needed by the agent payload, the report and tests; keeping them out of Qt makes all of it headless-testable.

decisions.chosen: Plane spanned by arch tangent (columns) and occlusal axis (rows, row 0 superior), slab averaged along the buccal normal, 0.3 mm pixels, crest line + crest_drop_mm reported
decisions.reason: Shows crest continuity along the ridge, which a buccolingual cross-section cannot; mirrors the cross-section convention without transposing the anatomy.

decisions.chosen: Keep upstream zhaoyouj/mcp-slicer 0.3.1 unmodified; repo ships .mcp.json (uvx mcp-slicer), a loopback REST-API Slicer launcher and an 11-check harness
decisions.reason: Verified working on Slicer 5.12.3 without vendoring a patched copy; the hardcoded port 2016 is documented as BL-16.

decisions.chosen: threading.Thread + 150 ms QTimer poll (180 ms debounce for tangential); timers stopped in cleanup()
decisions.reason: No QThread/Signal pattern exists in the codebase, and headless tests cannot construct Qt objects.
